description: This file defines a custom Android view named ContinueWatchingCard that displays a thumbnail, a progress bar indicating watch progress, and a title. It is designed for Android TV interfaces with focus handling and styling.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingCard
classes.description: A custom Android view representing a 'Continue Watching' card with a thumbnail, progress bar, and title. It handles focus animations and binds data from a ContentItem.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentItem data to the view, updating the title and progress bar.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on device density.
